verifications.claim: As of March 20, 2026, average 30-year fixed mortgage rates have moved back above 6.5%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate spiked to 6.53% today'; R4: 'top tier 30yr fixed mortgage rates are back over 6.5% for the average lender today'
verifications.reasoning: Both R1 and R4 directly state that on March 20, 2026, 30-year fixed rates exceeded 6.5%.

verifications.claim: As of March 20, 2026, average 30-year fixed mortgage rates rose from previous weekly lows in the 6.1%–6.2% range.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Mortgage rates rose in the second half of March, up to the 6.3% range from the low 6.2% range the previous week'
verifications.reasoning: R2 supports rise from previous week's low 6.2% range, but does not specify 6.1%–6.2% precisely; other refs mention earlier lows like 5.99% but not weekly.

verifications.claim: As of March 20, 2026, the average 30-year fixed rate is between 6.32% and 6.53%, notes WSJ and Mortgage News Daily.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2 (WSJ): 'Today’s national average on a 30-year fixed-rate mortgage is 6.32%'; R1 (citing Mortgage News Daily): 'The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate spiked to 6.53% today'; R4 (Mortgage News Daily): 'back over 6.5%'
verifications.reasoning: WSJ (R2) gives 6.32%, Mortgage News Daily sources (R1/R4) give 6.53%/over 6.5%, directly supporting the range and attribution on March 20.
